propositions: Debug skill reads prior tickets but never writes back, leaving RCA and reporting commentary absent from the tracker.
Step-7 sweep searches only by construct pattern, making parity siblings (parallel-surface absences) invisible to grep-based discovery.
Reporting allows residual fragility to evaporate without documented disposition (ticket filed, accepted with reason, or fixed in scope).

Writebacks and sibling-filing require discriminating between the project's own mandated tracker (un-gated) and third-party trackers (approval-gated) without contradicting existing approval-gate rules.

Step-7 requires a two-axis entry trigger (construct pattern OR parity-surface signature) and four forced-artifact questions (rule name, channel census with 5-slot checklist, per-surface probe citations, disposition) to surface parallel-surface bugs.
